node.title: M720 residual off-laptop zero certificates
node.statement: Every h=7..20 calibration cell not covered by the WSL-safe complete zero subcertificates is either explicitly outside the complete-cell certificate set as a window slice, or is one of the over-ceiling n=32,h=16 complete-window cells with a separate zero certificate.
node.attack_surface: assembly from residual slice metadata and over-ceiling complete-window certificates
node.falsifier: a residual complete calibration cell with nonzero unpaid non-toral active cores, or missing/false completeness metadata
